.yw-vinyl-arm::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-6px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);width:12px;height:16px;background:#fffaf0;border:1px solid #3b82f6;border-radius:2px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(44,62,80,0.3);}
.yw-vinyl-box.playing .yw-vinyl-arm{transform:rotate(-5deg);}
.yw-vinyl-box.playing .yw-vinyl-record{animation:vinylRotate 8s linear infinite;}
@keyframes vinylRotate{from{transform:rotate(0deg);}to{transform:rotate(360deg);}}
.yw-song-title{color:#2c3e50;font-size:14px;font-weight:bold;text-align:center;width:100%;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;margin-bottom:4px;}
.yw-progress{width:100%;height:6px;background:rgba(44,62,80,0.25);border-radius:3px;cursor:pointer;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:8px;}
.yw-progress-filled{height:100%;width:0%;background:#e74c3c;transition:width 0.1s linear;pointer-events:none;}
.yw-playlist{width:100%;height:160px;overflow-y:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:0;padding:6px;background:#fffaf0;border:1px solid rgba(44,62,80,0.35);border-radius:8px;scrollbar-width:thin;scrollbar-color:#3b82f6 transparent;}
.yw-playlist::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px;}
.yw-playlist::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#3b82f6;border-radius:2px;}
.yw-playlist p{margin:0;padding:10px 12px;font-size:12px;color:#2c3e50;cursor:pointer;border-radius:6px;transition:all 0.2s;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;display:flex;align-items:center;border-bottom:1px dashed rgba(44,62,80,0.25);}
.yw-playlist p:last-child{border-bottom:none;}
.yw-playlist p::before{content:'♪';font-size:10px;margin-right:8px;opacity:0.5;}
.yw-playlist p:hover{background:#f3ead8;transform:translateX(2px);}
.yw-playlist p.playing{color:#e74c3c;background:rgba(231,76,60,0.05);font-weight:bold;border-left:none!important;border-bottom-color:rgba(44,62,80,0.25);transform:translateX(0);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(231,76,60,0.22);}
.yw-playlist p.playing::before{content:'▶';color:#e74c3c;opacity:1;font-size:11px;}

回复出现问题怎么办？
回复截断、空白回复、奇怪语言乱入、道德审查打回、暴露英文思维链等现象，是各大模型官方API普遍存在的现象，建议换不同模型重试。

手动：若实在太长，手动复制之前的正确总结，开5电ai随便发送一句得到ai回复，将总结整合粘贴进回复中。

总结指令：务必每5~7轮使用一次！
